newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Aug 28.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Aug 28.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunkers were up on Wednesday as cargoes were supported. There was demand despite Singapore's relatively higher prices compared to region. Bunker 380-cst was at $106-$107 with 180-cst $4-$4.50 higher, compared to Tuesday's $105/$108 for 380-cst and $109/$111 for 180-cst. MDO and gas oil rose with cargoes, to $188-$194 and $203-207, versus $186/$191 and $200/$205 respectively.-- Singapore Newsroom (+65 870-3082).
